easyPrerequisites:
You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
Overgrowth is attached to one of the mana-producing lands.
description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Overgrowth triggers, adding {G}{G}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
